NinjaTrader Guide, Cash Accounts

Assigning Algos and Strategies to Your Cash Account

This walks you through reconnecting your algos in NinjaTrader after an updater and assigning them to your cash account, then clearing out the old strategies once the new ones are running.

If you wish to see the walkthrough video, you can watch it here. Otherwise, the steps below have you covered. Your progress is saved on this device.

0 of 6 steps complete

Tick each step as you go.

  1. 1

    Log into NinjaTrader

    A minute or two

    Your strategies reconnect to your cash account through NinjaTrader, so it needs to be fully loaded before you start reassigning anything.

    1. Double click the red icon for NinjaTrader to get it going.
    2. Log into your NinjaTrader.
    3. Wait until NinjaTrader is fully loaded before moving to the next step.
    Walkthrough 0:00 to 0:19
  2. 2

    Open the strategies list on the chart

    A minute

    This opens the list of strategies available to load onto that chart. As an example, this walkthrough uses RBO, but the same steps apply to any algo you are reassigning.

    1. On the actual algo chart, the one with the red and green candles, click right next to those candles rather than directly on them. Clicking on a candle drops a marker dot on the chart.
    2. Right click in that blank area next to the candles and go to Strategies.
    3. Your strategies load into the list on the left under Available.
    4. Find your algo in the list. Yours will be the version without PF in the title.
    Walkthrough 0:19 to 0:31
  3. 3

    Load the algo and its template

    A minute per algo

    Double clicking moves the strategy into Configured and gets it ready to run. Loading the set file that matches your account size keeps each algo on the settings intended for that allocation.

    1. Double click your algo in the Available list. It drops down into Configured.
    2. With it selected, go to Templates, then Load.
    3. Choose the set file for your account size. Set files are named by account dollar size, for example $15,000 Allocation Set File. The cash accounts allocator tells you the exact set file to load for each algo.
    Walkthrough 0:31 to 0:47
  4. 4

    Select your cash account and apply

    A minute

    This is what actually turns the algo on for your cash account. The Account field can show up in different spots depending on the strategy, so check both the top and bottom of the panel.

    1. Select the accounts field, which can sometimes be further down in some strategies.
    2. Select your particular cash account.
    3. Click Apply, then OK.
    4. Confirm you see that strategy show up in your Strategies tab.
    You'll need to repeat this reassigning process each time there is an updater.
    Walkthrough 0:47 to 1:00
  5. 5

    Repeat for the next algo

    A few minutes

    Each algo gets reassigned on its own chart, so you are not finished after the first one. Each algos tab gets matched up with its corresponding chart, one at a time, until it is completed for your arrangement.

    1. Start this process over from section 2, Open the strategies list on the chart.
    2. Find the next algos tab and its corresponding chart.
    3. Run sections 2 through 4 again for that algo.
    4. Keep matching each algos tab to its corresponding chart until it is completed for your arrangement.
  6. 6

    Remove the old strategies

    A minute

    Once the new strategies are reassigned and confirmed, the old ones from before the updater are just clutter and should come out so your Strategies tab only shows what's actually running.

    1. Select the old strategy or strategies you want out.
    2. Right click and choose Remove.
    Walkthrough 1:06 to 1:22

  7. Strategies reassigned

    Your algos are reconnected and assigned to your cash account on the set file for your account size, with the old pre-updater strategies removed. If anything looks off, open a support ticket in the Vincere Discord: support, submit-ticket.
